onboardingCoach.step1Body: Tap Open now and pick draw count or mode.
onboardingCoach.step2Body: Accept terms and complete mock payment on the order sheet.
onboardingCoach.step3Body: Open Warehouse tab to view prizes and shipping.
onboardingCoach.step4Body: Profile keeps highlights, balance, and invite rewards.
onboardingCoach.revealSkipBody: Tap to skip one prize, or Skip rest to finish the batch.
onboardingCoach.revealShareBody: On the settlement sheet, share a reveal poster of your pulls.
